inputs.text: This is state violence dressed up as security. Making execution the default for West Bank Palestinians convicted of killing Israelis would build unequal justice into the law, reserving the harshest punishment for one population. Ben-Gvir’s far-right party has introduced the bill, and its passage would reward a politics that turns fear into power rather than addressing the conditions that sustain violence. A system that answers violence with discriminatory punishment is not making people safer; it is deepening injustice.
